input.quote: This Agreement may not be assigned by either party, by operation of law or otherwise, without the prior written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, provided that (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party and as a result of which the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of another bank holding company, bank, savings and loan association or other financial institution having a capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000
input.rationale: Section 22.4 is asymmetric against us on a material term. M&I may freely assign in connection with a merger, corporate reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities, and to any successor to its Data Services division, with no consent and no competitor restriction. Our corresponding carve-out is available only for a merger, and only where the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of a financial institution with at least $100,000,000 of capital and surplus; we have no affiliate carve-out and no asset-sale carve-out, so an internal reorganisation or a sale of substantially all assets would require M&I's consent. That falls short of the fallback's mutual successor-assignment right, so we have added the customary affiliate/successor language mirroring M&I's own carve-out while leaving the Section 21.11 conditions intact. Noted but not separately redlined: there is no vendor termination or re-pricing right on our change of control (Section 11.3 is a Customer-side right and 21.11.B obliges M&I to continue Services), although 21.11.B caps post-change volumes at the prior three months plus 25%.

proposal.summary: Broaden Customer's assignment carve-out in 22.4 to cover Affiliates and successors in any merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, mirroring M&I's own free-assignment right.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the customary affiliate and successor carve-out for our own assignments: as drafted M&I may freely assign on a merger, reorganisation or asset sale while we may only do so on a merger to an acquirer with $100,000,000 of capital and surplus. This edit simply mirrors M&I's carve-out for us; we remain happy to keep the Section 21.11 conditions.

ops.oldText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party and as a result of which the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of another bank holding company, bank, savings and loan association or other financial institution having a capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000 so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with
ops.newText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement to an Affiliate of Customer or pursuant to a merger, acquisition, corporate reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assets, stock or securities of Customer, so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with
